statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of intermittent palpitations and subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats
The patient has suspected cardiac arrhythmia
CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring was ordered
The service is intended to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances by capturing electrocardiographic data during symptom onset
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service is medically necessary to establish whether reported symptoms correspond to a documented arrhythmia
